# Alora Radiance

> Luxury Ayurvedic-Inspired & Science-Backed Skincare. Dermatologist-tested, clean beauty formulations crafted with natural botanicals, saffron, niacinamide, ceramides, and clinically proven actives.

## About Alora Radiance
Alora Radiance is a modern Indian beauty brand delivering high-performance skincare. We blend ancient Ayurvedic botanical wisdom with cutting-edge dermatological science. All formulations are 100% cruelty-free, paraben-free, sulfate-free, toxin-free, FDA compliant, and GMP certified.

## Core Product Catalog
- Purifying Glow Face Wash (200ml): Gentle clarifying cleanser with Saffron Extract, Salicylic Acid, and Niacinamide. Removes impurities, balances sebum, and unclogs pores.
- Brightening & Hydrating Face Serum (30ml): Intensive antioxidant serum featuring Kashmiri Saffron, 5% Niacinamide, Hyaluronic Acid, and Vitamin E.
- Soothing Face Scrub (100g): Gentle micro-exfoliator formulated with Walnut, Almond, Pomegranate extract, and botanical emollients.
- Daily Glow Duo (Combo): Synergistic pair of Purifying Glow Face Wash + Brightening Face Serum.
- Watermelon Cooling Gel (100g / 200g): Lightweight, ultra-hydrating gel with 99% Watermelon extract and Hyaluronic acid.

## Key Active Ingredients
- Kashmiri Saffron (Crocus Sativus): Natural skin brightening & radiant glow.
- Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Strengthens skin barrier & minimizes pores.
- Salicylic Acid (BHA): Deep pore cleansing & blackhead prevention.
- Ceramides & Hyaluronic Acid: Deep hydration & moisture barrier repair.
- SPF 30++ UV Filters: Broad-spectrum UVA/UVB photo-protection.
